40021877.author: पदार्थः
40021877.content: तत्र there, तां that, रजनीम् night, उष्य having stayed, केशिन्यां in Keshini, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, प्रभाते in the morning, पुनरुत्थाय having risen again, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रययौ departed, तदा then,

40021877.author: Translation
40021877.content: Having stayed that night in Keshini, Lakshmana, the delight of the Raghus, rose again in the morning and then departed.

40021878.author: पदार्थः
40021878.content: ततः then, अर्धदिवसे at midday, प्राप्ते having arrived, प्रविवेश he entered, महारथः the great warrior, अयोध्यां Ayodhya, रत्नसम्पूर्णां full of jewels, हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताम् filled with happy and well-nourished people,

40021878.author: Translation
40021878.content: Then, at midday, the great warrior Lakshmana entered Ayodhya, which was full of jewels and teeming with happy and well-nourished people.

40021879.author: पदार्थः
40021879.content: सौमित्रिस्तु Saumitri (Lakshmana) indeed, परं extreme, दैन्यं distress, जगाम experienced, सुमहामतिः the very intelligent one. रामपादौ Rama's feet, समासाद्य having approached, वक्ष्यामि shall I say, किम् what, अहम् I, गतः having gone?

40021879.author: Translation
40021879.content: The highly intelligent Lakshmana was overcome with extreme distress, wondering what he would say to Rama upon reaching his feet.

40021880.author: पदार्थः
40021880.content: तस्य his, एवम् thus, चिन्तयानस्य while thinking, भवनं palace, शशिसन्निभम् moon-like, रामस्य Rama's, परमोदारम् most magnificent, पुरस्तात् in front, समदृश्यत appeared.

40021880.author: Translation
40021880.content: As he was thus contemplating, Rama's most magnificent palace, shining like the moon, appeared before him.

40021881.author: पदार्थः
40021881.content: राज्ञः of the king, तु indeed, भवनद्वारि at the palace gate, सः he, अवतीर्य having alighted, रथोत्तमात् from the excellent chariot, अवाङ्मुखः with downcast face, दीनमनाः with a sorrowful mind, प्रविवेश entered, अनिवारितः unhindered.

40021881.author: Translation
40021881.content: At the king's palace gate, he alighted from his excellent chariot and, with a downcast face and sorrowful mind, entered unhindered.

40021882.author: पदार्थः
40021882.content: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, राघवम् Rama, दीनम् distressed, आसीनम् seated, परमासने on the excellent seat, नेत्राभ्याम् with eyes, अश्रुपूर्णाभ्याम् filled with tears, ददर्श saw, अग्रजम् his elder brother, अग्रतः in front.

40021882.author: Translation
40021882.content: He saw Rama, his elder brother, seated on an excellent seat in front of him, looking distressed, and his own eyes filled with tears.

40021883.author: पदार्थः
40021883.content: जग्राह grasped, चरणौ feet, तस्य his, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनचेतनः with a sorrowful mind, उवाच spoke, दीनया with a humble, वाचा voice, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, सुसमाहितः very composed.

40021883.author: Translation
40021883.content: Lakshmana, with a sorrowful mind, grasped Rama's feet and, with folded hands and a very composed yet humble voice, began to speak.

40021884.author: पदार्थः
40021884.content: आर्यस्य your, आज्ञाम् command, पुरस्कृत्य having followed, विसृज्य having left, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, गङ्गातीरे on the bank of the Ganga, यथोद्दिष्टे as instructed, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, आश्रमे in the hermitage, शुचौ pure,

40021884.author: Translation
40021884.content: Having followed your command, I left Janaka's daughter on the pure bank of the Ganga, in Valmiki's hermitage as instructed.

40021885.author: पदार्थः
40021885.content: तत्र there, ताम् her, च and, शुभाचाराम् of auspicious conduct, आश्रमान्ते at the edge of the hermitage, यशस्विनीम् glorious, पुनरपि again, आगतः I have come, वीर O hero, पादमूलम् at your feet, उपासितुम् to serve,

40021885.author: Translation
40021885.content: O hero, I have returned to serve at your feet, having left her, who is of auspicious conduct and glorious, there at the edge of the hermitage.

40021886.author: पदार्थः
40021886.content: मा शुचः do not grieve, पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, कालस्य of time, गतिः the course, ईदृशी such, त्वद्विधाः those like you, न हि certainly not, शोचन्ति grieve, बुद्धिमन्तः intelligent ones, मनस्विनः wise ones,

40021886.author: Translation
40021886.content: O tiger among men, do not grieve, for such is the course of time, and intelligent, high-minded individuals like you certainly do not lament.

40021887.author: पदार्थः
40021887.content: सर्वे all, क्षयान्ताः ending in decay, निचयाः accumulations, पतनान्ताः ending in fall, समुच्छ्रयाः elevations, संयोगाः unions, विप्रयोगान्ताः ending in separation, मरणान्तम् ending in death, च and, जीवितम् life,

40021887.author: Translation
40021887.content: All accumulations end in decay, all elevations end in a fall, all unions end in separation, and life itself ends in death.

40021888.author: पदार्थः
40021888.content: तस्मात् therefore, पुत्रेषु in sons, दारेषु in wives, मित्रेषु in friends, च and, धनेषु in wealth, च and, न अतिप्रसङ्गः no excessive attachment, कर्तव्यः should be done, विप्रयोगः separation, हि indeed, तैः from them, ध्रुवम् certain,

40021888.author: Translation
40021888.content: Therefore, one should not have excessive attachment to sons, wives, friends, or wealth, for separation from them is indeed inevitable.

40021889.author: पदार्थः
40021889.content: शक्तः capable, त्वम् you, आत्मना by yourself, आत्मानम् your own self, विनेतुम् to control, मनसा by mind, एव indeed, हि surely, लोकान् worlds, सर्वान् all, च and, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, किम् पुनः what then, शोकम् sorrow, आत्मनः your own.

40021889.author: Translation
40021889.content: O Kakutstha, you are surely capable of controlling your own self and indeed all worlds by your mind, so how much more easily can you control your own sorrow?

40021890.author: पदार्थः
40021890.content: न not, ईदृशेषु in such matters, विमुह्यन्ति become bewildered, त्वद्विधाः those like you, पुरुषर्षभाः best among men, अपवादः blame, सः that, किल indeed, ते to you, पुनः again, एष्यति will come, राघव O Raghava.

40021890.author: Translation
40021890.content: Best among men like you do not become bewildered in such situations, and indeed, O Raghava, that very blame will come upon you again.

40021891.author: पदार्थः
40021891.content: यदर्थम् for which reason, मैथिली Maithili, त्यक्ता abandoned, अपवादभयात् from fear of blame, नृप O King, सः that, अपवादः blame, पुरे in the city, राजन् O King, भविष्यति will be, न संशयः no doubt.

40021891.author: Translation
40021891.content: O King, that very blame for which Maithili was abandoned out of fear of scandal will undoubtedly arise again among the people in the city.

40021892.author: पदार्थः
40021892.content: सः such, त्वम् you, पुरुषशार्दूल O best of men, धैर्येण with fortitude, सुसमाहितः well-composed, त्यज abandon, एनाम् this, दुर्बलाम् weak, बुद्धिम् thought, सन्तापम् grief, मा कुरुष्व do not make, ह indeed.

40021892.author: Translation
40021892.content: O best of men, you, being well-composed with fortitude, should abandon this weak thought and indeed do not give in to grief.

40021893.author: पदार्थः
40021893.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, सः that, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, महात्मना by the great-souled one, उवाच spoke, परया with great, प्रीत्या affection, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, मित्रवत्सलः affectionate towards friends.

40021893.author: Translation
40021893.content: Thus addressed by the great-souled Lakshmana, that Kakutstha, who was affectionate towards his friends, spoke to Saumitri with great affection.

40021894.author: पदार्थः
40021894.content: एवम् thus, एतत् this, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, यथा as, वदसि you speak, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, परितोषः satisfaction, च and, मे my, वीर O hero, मम my, कार्यानुशासने in the instruction of duty.

40021894.author: Translation
40021894.content: O best among men, Lakshmana, this is indeed as you say, and I am greatly satisfied, O hero, with your counsel regarding my duty.

40021895.author: पदार्थः
40021895.content: निवृत्तिः cessation, च and, आगता has come, सौम्य O gentle one, सन्तापः sorrow, च and, निराकृतः removed, भवद्वाक्यैः by your words, सुरुचिरैः very pleasing, अनुनीतः अस्मि I have been comforted, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana.

40021895.author: Translation
40021895.content: O gentle Lakshmana, relief has come, and my sorrow has been dispelled; I have been comforted by your very pleasing words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 52 ।। Thus ends the fifty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
